gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement Total Governmental Funds column prints transfers net 175,000 in (p6), which the statement JSON uses (other side: Electric Fund 'Transfers to other funds' (175,000), p8). detail[] records them gross per fund: ins General Fund 'Transfers from other funds' 182,584 (p17) + Sales Tax Fund 12,355 (p13) = 194,939; outs Street Fund (19,129) (p12) + Community Redevelopment Authority Fund (810) (p16) = 19,939. 194,939 - 19,939 = 175,000 = printed net. The 19,939 gap is the intra-governmental transfers recorded gross; no fix.

Proprietary funds statement of revenues, expenses and changes in net position (p8) prints Electric, Water, Sewer and Trash Fund columns; no business-type lines in detail[]. Statement receipts[] = Sales + Insurance proceeds + Other revenue + Gain (loss) on investments + Grant income. Electric: 946,449 + 34,347 + 9,580 + 2,343 = 992,719; Water: 177,059 + 10,234 + 1,922 + 1,459 + 46,113 = 236,787; Sewer: 49,364; Trash: 82,537 + 12,394 + 1,129 = 96,060. Sum 1,374,930 = statement total.
